name: ecom Ex-Handy 10 DZ1
statusNote: Resellers list it as obsolete, replaced by the Smart-Ex 03 DZ1.
summary: The ecom Ex-Handy 10 DZ1 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ib) feature phone from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx, and for Class I Division 1 in North America. It runs Android 9. It has been discontinued; the ecom Smart-Ex 03 DZ1 replaces it.

otherSchemes: INMETRO marking on Brazil version (cert no. not captured)

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ib op is IIC T4 Gb IP64 / II 2D Ex ib op is IIIC T120°C Db

iecex.marking: Ex ib op is IIC T4 Gb IP64 / Ex ib op is IIIC T120°C Db

certification.northAmerica: CSA: I.S. Class I Div 1 Groups A-D T4; Class II, III Div 1 Groups E-G T120°C; CL I Zone 1 AEx ib op is IIC T4 Gb; Zone 21 AEx ib op is IIIC T120°C Db
certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ib) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: See Ex-Handy 10 DZ1 safety instructions (not reviewed)

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 1 in North America
Certified for ambient temperatures up to +60 °C
limitations: Discontinued; the ecom Smart-Ex 03 DZ1 replaces it
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
